title: Global Esports exits VALORANT Champions Shanghai after heartbreaking loss to LOUD
summary: Global Esports' (GE) remarkable international run reached its final chapter on Sunday following a hard-fought loss to former world champions LOUD in the VALORANT Champions Shanghai decider match.
